## Controlling animations

`fox.sprite` gets the Sprite the Actor is playing. Setting it switches the animation. Setting the same Sprite again restarts it only if it has finished, so it is safe to set every frame.

```{.python include="code/fox_animation.py" snippet="sprites"}
```
